cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# ============================================================================
# Darkwatch (Xbox, 2005) - static recompilation
#
#   Windows : MSVC + D3D11 backend
#   macOS   : Clang + OpenGL 3.3 backend (SDL2 + libepoxy)
#
# The recompiled guest code lives in src/recomp/gen/ (generated by
# tools.recomp from the toolkit clone; see scripts/regenerate_recomp.sh).
#
# Configure:  cmake -S . -B build
# Build:      cmake --build build --config Release
# ============================================================================

project(darkwatch_recomp C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

add_compile_definitions(
    WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
    NOMINMAX
)

# ── xboxrecomp toolkit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Default search order: a clone beside the project, then inside it.
if(NOT XBOXRECOMP_DIR)
    foreach(_cand
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/xboxrecomp"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/xboxrecomp"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../xboxrecomp")
        if(EXISTS "${_cand}/CMakeLists.txt")
            set(XBOXRECOMP_DIR "${_cand}")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
set(XBOXRECOMP_DIR "${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}" CACHE PATH
    "Path to the xboxrecomp toolkit root directory")

if(NOT XBOXRECOMP_DIR OR NOT EXISTS "${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "xboxrecomp toolkit not found.\n"
        "Clone it, e.g.:\n"
        "  git clone https://github.com/sp00nznet/xboxrecomp tools/xboxrecomp\n"
        "or point -DXBOXRECOMP_DIR= at an existing clone.")
endif()

# ── Indirect-branch feedback ────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# ON by default: the recompiled dispatch cannot see where a vtable call goes,
# so the runtime records every indirect target it observes (resolved and not)
# and dumps them on exit. Feed the dump back with
#   python -m tools.recomp.icall_feedback merge icall_targets.dump
#   python -m tools.disasm --seed-functions tools/recomp/output/icall_targets.json
# and the unresolved stubs become real functions. It costs one OR per indirect
# call; turn it OFF for a release build once the target set has converged.
#
# Before add_subdirectory: the recording arrays and the dump live in
# xbox_kernel (src/kernel/icall_feedback.c), and the store into them is
# inlined into the generated code, so the definition has to reach the
# toolkit's libraries as well as this project's sources.
option(DARKWATCH_ICALL_FEEDBACK "Record indirect-branch targets for the recompiler" ON)
if(DARKWATCH_ICALL_FEEDBACK)
    add_compile_definitions(RECOMP_ICALL_FEEDBACK)
    message(STATUS "ICALL feedback: ON (dump: icall_targets.dump)")
endif()

add_subdirectory(${XBOXRECOMP_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xboxrecomp)
# ── Recompiled guest code ───────────────────────────────────────────────
file(GLOB RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "src/recomp/gen/*.c")

if(NOT RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "src/recomp/gen/ is empty. Generate the recompiled code first:\n"
        "  bash scripts/regenerate_recomp.sh")
endif()

list(LENGTH RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES RECOMP_GEN_COUNT)
message(STATUS "Recompiled sources: ${RECOMP_GEN_COUNT} files")

# ── Host bootstrap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(GAME_SOURCES
    src/config.c
    src/display.c
    src/recomp_manual.c
)

if(WIN32)
    list(APPEND GAME_SOURCES src/main_win32.c)
else()
    list(APPEND GAME_SOURCES src/main_posix.c)
endif()

if(WIN32)
    add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} WIN32 ${GAME_SOURCES} ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES})
else()
    # POSIX: a plain console executable. The SDL window is created by the
    # D3D8 GL backend when the guest creates its device.
    add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} ${GAME_SOURCES} ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES})
endif()

if(DARKWATCH_ICALL_FEEDBACK)
    target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE RECOMP_ICALL_FEEDBACK)
endif()

# Drop the default options file next to the executable on first configure.
# It is never overwritten: edits to build/darkwatch.ini survive a re-configure.
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/darkwatch.ini")
    file(COPY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config/darkwatch.ini"
         DESTINATION "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
    message(STATUS "Options file: ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/darkwatch.ini")
endif()

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE xboxrecomp)

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/recomp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/recomp/gen
    ${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/include
    ${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/src/d3d
)

if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        d3d11 dxgi dxguid xinput winmm dbghelp)
    if(MSVC)
        target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE)
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /bigobj)
    endif()
endif()

# The generated code is machine output: do not drown the build log in
# warnings from it, but keep them for the hand-written files.
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -O2 -w)
    set_source_files_properties(
        src/main_posix.c src/config.c src/display.c src/recomp_manual.c
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wall;-Wextra;-Wno-unused-parameter")
endif()
